name: Yidi Lian
source: A mostly-text-based game about remote relationships, told in the format of chat programs. Special memories are made during the time of high school and college, but what will you choose for your future?
translation: 一款关于远程关系的主要基于文本的游戏，以聊天程序的形式讲述。高中和大学的时光给你留下了特别的回忆，但你会为自己的未来做出怎样的选择呢？
